sections.A: Hip OA mein kooleh ke jor ka cartilage dheere dheere ghisna aur jor mein tabdeeli hoti hai. Yeh lambi bimari hai lekin exercise se behtar sambhali ja sakti hai.
sections.B: Ran ke jor (groin) ya hip ke aage dard jo ran ya ghutne tak ja sakta hai, subah ka thora akdan, aur chalne ya seerhiyon par barhna.
sections.C: Dard kahan hai (groin, side, kooleh, ghutna) aur kaun se kaam mushkil hain.
sections.D: Chaal (langrana, Trendelenburg), hip ki range (khaas kar internal rotation aur flexion) aur taaqat.
sections.E: Koi aik test hip OA confirm nahi karta. Dard ke saath kam range, typical history aur X-ray milkar diagnosis banate hain.
sections.F: Gluteal tendinopathy (side ka dard), FAI aur kamar se aata dard isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Girne ke baad wazan na utha sakna, chhoti aur bahar mudi taang (fracture), ya garam sooja jor aur bukhar (infection): foran refer.
sections.H: 45 saal se zyada, kaam se barhne wala groin dard, subah ka akdan 30 minute se kam: clinical diagnosis hip OA.
sections.I: Hip mobilisation (distraction aur glides) thori der ka aaraam aur range deti hai, exercise ke saath.
sections.J: Exercise aur education pehli line ka ilaaj hain: taaqat, range aur aerobic exercise, aur zaroorat ho to wazan kam karna.
sections.K: Garmi aur TENS optional. Dawa ya injection doctor ka faisla.
sections.L: Kamar aur ghutna screen karein, aasaan alfaaz mein OA samjhayein, aur 6 se 12 hafte ka exercise program. Behtari na ho to surgeon.
sections.M: Dard, HOOS, internal rotation, hip ki taaqat, 30-second chair stand aur TUG dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 64 saal ki khatoon ko 2 saal se groin se ghutne tak dard hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education, exercise aur zaroorat ho to wazan kam karna.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
